teaser: A toolkit gets checked before anyone else is awake. Life path 8 and ISTP meet at the bench, not the boardroom, though the boardroom is usually where the 8 ends up anyway. The 8 wants the material world mastered — leverage, outcome, the next rung. ISTP wants the thing in front of it understood by hand, taken apart, rebuilt cleaner. In one person these don't compete so much as take turns: the hands solve the problem the ambition set, then the ambition cashes it in.
excerpt: The vet clinic with the flickering overhead light, the one maintenance keeps meaning to fix.
